Best Dual-Monitor DisplayPort KVM Switches

A dual-monitor DisplayPort KVM switch lets you control two computers using the same two monitors, keyboard, and mouse, switching between computers with a button or hotkey.

For a good setup, I'd prioritize:

DisplayPort 1.4 or newer

Dual 4K @ 60Hz minimum

4K @ 144Hz or higher for gaming

USB 3.0 for keyboard, mouse, and peripherals

EDID emulation to reduce monitor rearrangement when switching

A wired remote switch button for convenience

chats.answer:
If you're looking for a dual-monitor DisplayPort KVM switch, you'll want one that lets you connect two computers to two monitors and switch both displays, your keyboard, and your mouse together.

For a good setup, I'd prioritize:

2 computers × 2 monitors with 4 DisplayPort inputs and 2 DisplayPort outputs.

DisplayPort 1.4 or 2.1, depending on your monitor resolution and refresh rate.

USB 3.0 or faster for keyboard, mouse, webcam, and other peripherals.

EDID emulation to help prevent windows from rearranging when switching computers.

Hotkey or remote switching, so you don't have to reach behind your desk.
